summary: Steep through-road kerb on a bend, no parking along it.
reasons: Through road, no kerbside parking seen

flags: Steep: about 12.4% mean over the stretch, 4.8% at best section

best_section.where: East end of the south kerb of Carawa Street by the golf car park
